title: How to Rank Up Faster in Shadowrealm: A Progression Guide
subtitle: The eight rank thresholds, and the order in which to spend your energy, talents and gold.
description: How to rank up faster in Shadowrealm: the XP needed for all eight ranks, which city to work in, what to upgrade first, and how the stronghold and bank help.
card: All eight rank thresholds in Shadowrealm and a priority list for progressing faster: cities, talents, gear, the Reliquary and the stronghold.

faq.q: How much XP do I need for each rank in Shadowrealm?
faq.a: The thresholds are Peasant 0, Cutpurse 1,000, Bandit 5,000, Reaver 20,000, Cutthroat 75,000, Warlock 250,000, Shadowblade 700,000 and Wraithking 2,600,000 XP. Each step is roughly three to four times the previous one.

faq.q: How many talent points do I get?
faq.a: You earn 5 talent points for every rank after the first. Seven rank-ups from Peasant to Wraithking give 35 points in total, which you spend across your stats. Luck and stamina are good first picks for progression.

At the top rank you can Ascend. Your rank resets, but you keep gold, gear, guild and stronghold, and you gain Ascension Points for a prestige tree. The process is repeatable, so the game continues after rank 8.
